turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good evening. Tonight we look at how the river shaped the old town, and why the bridge was moved twice.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Thank you. The first bridge stood further downstream, close to where the market square is today.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And the second one was built after the flood of the following decade, is that right?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That is right. The flood took the mill with it, and the council decided to rebuild on higher ground, where the road already crossed.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Which brings us to the stone bridge we still walk across today. Thank you for joining us this evening.
